post_hoc: Reconstructed after the run (Codex review finding: mcp-servers recorded no executable hashes). The command below is the one run; the binaries are still at these paths, hashed now, and their mtimes predate the run. Later runs write mcp_servers_manifest.json themselves.
config: taskset -c 6; OXIDE_EMBED_SESSIONS=1 and hashed embedder via hashed_env(); corpora pytest,pylint parity copies under /tmp/oxide-lean-parity/idx
argv: taskset -c 6 python3 scripts/corpus_load_baseline.py mcp-servers --work /tmp/oxide-lean-parity --corpora pytest,pylint --oxide /tmp/oxide-lean-bench/bin/oxide-base --profile /tmp/oxide-lean-bench/bin/profile-base --challenger-oxide /tmp/oxide-lean-bench/bin/oxide-final --challenger-profile /tmp/oxide-lean-bench/bin/profile-final --aa-control --out raw/mcp-pg32 --servers 40 --warmup 3 --steady 16 --seed 2
